extracted.name: Green Beans and Ham
extracted.description: Ham steak, green beans, red new potatoes, and onions go into this satisfying one-pot dinner that's quick and easy to make on any weeknight.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 pound) ham steak, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed and halved
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place ham steak, potatoes, green beans, onion, and butter in a large pot with just enough water to cover. Season with salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
